purpose: Compare the current exported fixed operator factor with a benchmark-only native SuiteSparseQR factor state, separately from ordering effects.
case_selection_reason: cube-512 and cube-1024 are the largest completed one-level Schwarz search points with current-COLAMD data; cube-1024 is near the fixed 4 GiB envelope and directly tests whether representation cost changes that frontier.

measurement.preconditioner: Schwarz at cube-512/1024; diagonal and Schwarz at cube-2048 diagnostics
measurement.rank_certificate: LocalSupport before native QR; exact existing Fixed plus bounded SPQR fallback when certification is unavailable
measurement.cube_2048_policy: Diagnostic retries only after cube-1024 BEST/native reduced RSS with matched search parity; all retries retained the original 4 GiB / 600 s envelope.
measurement.status_semantics: All requested runs produced a terminal completed or rss_limit record; a resource stop is retained as a failure, not a completed measurement.

promotion_decision.reason: Native representation had matched discrete search behavior where paired completed runs existed, but COLAMD RSS margin remained within run variation and every cube-2048 retry exceeded 4 GiB before PCG. Candidate remains benchmark-only.
